source.source_constraint: Product descriptors were derived from product titles, structured product attributes, and meaningful alphabetic words in the existing product handle.

rules.semantic_order: gender + material/composition + distinguishing print/neck/sleeve/opening/pocket/legacy descriptor + fit + product type + colour
rules.minimal_specificity: A descriptive attribute is added only when it helps separate otherwise identical base URLs.
rules.indistinguishable_fallback: A stable alphabetic design reference is appended only after all available product-specific descriptors still leave a collision.
rules.h1: Existing source-backed H1 tags remain unchanged.

authenticity_note: Detector scoring was not run because URL slugs are structured metadata fragments rather than prose. The applicable authenticity gate was factual source coverage; no new product claim was introduced without source data.
